children: A crypto market surge has helped Huang Licheng, known as "Machi Big Brother," recover his leveraged positions after his contract account had fallen to just $800,000. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, his total net asset value has climbed back above $11 million.

TradingBeats reported that Huang's current positions include an ETH long worth about $82.69 million with unrealized gains of about $4.28 million, opened at $2,611.45 and liquidated at $2,452.66. His BTC long is worth about $29.09 million with unrealized gains of about $880,000, opened at $83,225.30 and liquidated at $59,335.61. He also holds a HYPE long worth about $15.18 million with unrealized gains of about $140,000, opened at $93.08 and liquidated at $36.18.

title: Crypto Market Rally Lifts Huang Licheng's Trading Account Above $11 Million
